title: ICC-ES ESR-4733: SmartLam cross-laminated timber (CLT)
jurisdiction: United States (ICC-ES evaluation report under IBC/IRC); NON-ALBERTA COMPARATIVE ONLY: cannot establish Alberta performance, acceptance or equivalence; no Canadian or Alberta approval is claimed or implied
code_edition: 2018, 2015, 2012 and 2009 IBC and IRC (report §1.1, p1); CALGreen 2022 and ICC 700 (§1.2, p1)
document_date: Reissued December 2024; subject to renewal December 2026 (p1)

facts.text: Report holder SMARTLAM, LLC; subject is SmartLam CLT.
Components in floors, roofs and walls in Type III (interior floors only), Types IV and V, and roofs in Type I and II (IBC); IRC use requires an engineered design.
Connections of wall, floor and roof panels must be designed by a registered design professional per the NDS or ICC-ES-recognized connectors.
Cutting, drilling and notching are outside the evaluation; beams or lintels loaded parallel to glue lines are outside the report.
Out-of-plane wall use requires complete detailing and wall design acceptable to the code official.
Unbalanced layups must be installed per §4.2; panels are manufactured at a SmartLam LLC facility.
Evidence listed: ICC-ES AC455, dated February 2019, editorially revised June 2020.

limitations: Non-Alberta comparative attachment; the report does not reference NBC(AE) 2023 and is not evidence of Alberta or Canadian acceptance.
